title: Inqubomgomo Yamakhukhi
html:
Le Nqubomgomo Yamakhukhi ichaza indlela i-Kyber (“thina”, “kithi” kanye “nokwethu”) esebenzisa ngayo amakhukhi nobunye ubuchwepheshe obufanayo ukuze ikubone uma uvakashela iwebhusayithi yethu ku-https://kyber.stream (“iWebhusayithi”). Ichaza ukuthi buyini lobu buchwepheshe nokuthi kungani sibusebenzisa, kanye namalungelo akho okulawula indlela esibusebenzisa ngayo.

Ayini amakhukhi?

Amakhukhi ngamafayela amancane edatha afakwa kukhompyutha yakho noma kudivayisi yakho ephathekayo uma uvakashela iwebhusayithi. Amakhukhi asetshenziswa kabanzi ngabanikazi bamawebhusayithi ukuze amawebhusayithi abo asebenze, noma asebenze ngempumelelo enkulu, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngolwazi lokubika.

Kungani sisebenzisa amakhukhi?

Sisebenzisa amakhukhi ethu siqu kanye namakhukhi ezinhlangothi zesithathu ngezizathu eziningana. Amanye amakhukhi ayadingeka ngenxa yezizathu zobuchwepheshe ukuze iWebhusayithi yethu isebenze, futhi lawa siwabiza ngokuthi amakhukhi “abalulekile” noma “adingeka ngokuqinile”. Amanye amakhukhi asenza sikwazi ukulandelela nokuqondisa izithakazelo zabasebenzisi bethu ukuze sithuthukise okuhlangenwe nakho kuWebhusayithi yethu. Izinhlangothi zesithathu zifaka amakhukhi ngeWebhusayithi yethu ngezinjongo zokukhangisa, zokuhlaziya kanye nezinye izinjongo.

Ngingawalawula kanjani amakhukhi?

Unelungelo lokunquma ukuthi uyawamukela noma uyawenqaba yini amakhukhi. Ungasebenzisa okuthandayo mayelana namakhukhi ngokuchofoza izixhumanisi ezifanele zokwenqaba ezihlinzekwe esibhengezweni samakhukhi osibona uma uqala ukuvakashela iWebhusayithi yethu.

Ungasetha noma ulungise izilawuli zesiphequluli sakho sewebhu ukuze samukele noma senqabe amakhukhi. Uma ukhetha ukwenqaba amakhukhi, usengayisebenzisa iWebhusayithi yethu, nakuba ukufinyelela kwakho kweminye imisebenzi nezingxenye zeWebhusayithi yethu kungase kukhawulelwe.

Niyoyibuyekeza kangaki le Nqubomgomo Yamakhukhi?

Singase siyibuyekeze le Nqubomgomo Yamakhukhi ngezikhathi ezithile ukuze ibonise, ngokwesibonelo, izinguquko kumakhukhi esiwasebenzisayo noma ngenxa yezinye izizathu zokusebenza, ezomthetho noma ezokulawula. Ngakho-ke sicela uyivakashele kabusha le Nqubomgomo Yamakhukhi njalo ukuze uhlale wazi ngokusebenzisa kwethu amakhukhi nobuchwepheshe obuhlobene nawo.

Usuku olungenhla kwale Nqubomgomo Yamakhukhi lubonisa ukuthi yagcina nini ukubuyekezwa.

Ngingalutholaphi ulwazi olwengeziwe?

Uma unemibuzo mayelana nokusebenzisa kwethu amakhukhi noma obunye ubuchwepheshe, sicela usithumelele i-imeyili ku-dpo@kyber.media.
